description: This file defines a mock class 'ServerMock' for the 'IServer' interface used in IPC (Inter-Process Communication) testing within the Rialto project. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for testing server behaviors such as adding sockets, adding clients, and processing events.
external_methods: MOCK_METHOD(bool, addSocket, (const std::string &socketPath, std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<IClient> &)> clientConnectedCb, std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<IClient> &)> clientDisconnectedCb), (override))
MOCK_METHOD(std::shared_ptr<IClient>, addClient, (int socketFd, std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<IClient> &)> clientDisconnectedCb), (override))
